info.name: Get Current Registration Step
info.description: API to get the current registration step and all filled data for a user

request.description:
Returns the current registration step and all filled information for a user. Helps frontend to:
1. Show which step user is currently on
2. Resume registration from where they left off
3. Pre-fill form fields with existing data
4. Show progress indicator
5. Validate if user can proceed to next step
